description:
# Phase outcome

Extension foundation. Entry: public client, policy, sequence, and execution seams. Exit: data-only requests resolve to trusted built-in or process extensions with lifecycle events and project trust.

# Ranked child stories

1. `jido_cli-tqg.4.1` — Add data-only extension requests to agent documents (P1)
2. `jido_cli-tqg.4.2` — Define trusted extension identity and permission bindings (P1)
3. `jido_cli-tqg.4.3` — Emit versioned portable extension lifecycle events (P1)
4. `jido_cli-tqg.4.4` — Add the built-in Jidoka extension host (P1)
5. `jido_cli-tqg.4.5` — Specify the process-extension protocol v1 (P2)
6. `jido_cli-tqg.4.6` — Host trusted process extensions as operation sources (P2)
7. `jido_cli-tqg.4.7` — Resolve trusted extensions and project trust in both CLI modes (P2)

# Status rule

All child stories remain open. Story dependency links, not priority alone, control implementation order.
title: Phase 3: Define the extension host before extensions
